description: China Earthquake Science Data Center (国家地震科学数据中心) is a database run by China Earthquake Administration. The data centre serves seismic waveform, catalogue, strong-motion, active-fault, geophysical and earthquake-damage data of the China Earthquake Administration and its institutes through a registration-based request system. Coverage: China. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as text, csv; access is free of charge for research use with registration and applications. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("国家地震科学数据中心") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support seismic hazard and damage studies of Chinese infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
